optional_measurement_steps.runtime: ordinary Python with NumPy and Pillow

validation_after_acceptance: Copy chosen model/render into isolated models/bishop and assets/bishop.
Run validate_checkpoint.py in Blender; this exports the exact current mesh and checks geometry, materials, slit, camera and references.
Run render_diagnostics.py and render_clay.py from that saved model.
Run mission_compare.py, material_statistics.py and compare.py; inspect the actual resulting images.
Run refresh_review.py, check_viewer.cjs and check_review.cjs. Save the viewer check JSON from stdout as assets/bishop/viewer-validation.json.
Collect the bishop checkpoint; synchronize canonical and existing preview assets; run affected site checks; commit only bishop work.
note: Final recorded light values reproduce the accepted scene without refitting. Sampling and Blender serialization may change file bytes on a rebuild; compare declared geometry, material, lighting, camera and rendered evidence rather than demanding an identical regenerated .blend file hash.
